achievements.title: the Giant-Killer

achievements.name: It Should Not Exist
achievements.flavor: You have seen it now. That is permanent.

achievements.name: Monster Hunter
achievements.desc: Slay a legendary horror in a descent or raid.
achievements.flavor: It had a name. Now it has a grave.

achievements.name: Slayer of Myths
achievements.flavor: The horror movies are documentaries now, and you're in them.
achievements.title: Slayer of Myths

achievements.desc: Slay a dozen horrors with names.

achievements.name: Ink on a Blank Map
achievements.desc: Seed a new game's Pact list with a free !pactadd.
achievements.flavor: Every map starts as an empty page.

achievements.name: Surveyor of the Unknown
achievements.desc: Seed 2 free Pacts into new lists.
achievements.flavor: You walk where the wheel has no slices yet.

achievements.name: Cartographer
achievements.desc: Seed 4 free Pacts into new lists.
achievements.flavor: The margins say: here be horrors. You wrote that.

achievements.name: Charting the Abyss
achievements.desc: Seed 7 free Pacts into new lists.
achievements.flavor: Depth soundings, taken by hand.

achievements.name: Mapper of Leng
achievements.desc: Seed 11 free Pacts into new lists.
achievements.flavor: The plateau is cold, and your ink froze twice.
achievements.title: the Mapmaker

achievements.name: Drafter of Forbidden Coasts
achievements.desc: Seed 16 free Pacts into new lists.
achievements.flavor: Some shores are only on your maps.

achievements.name: Atlas of Dread
achievements.desc: Seed 22 free Pacts into new lists.
achievements.flavor: Bound in leather. Probably leather.

achievements.name: Measurer of Wrong Angles
achievements.desc: Seed 30 free Pacts into new lists.
achievements.flavor: Your compass points somewhere that isn't a direction.

achievements.name: Chartmaker of Kadath
achievements.desc: Seed 40 free Pacts into new lists.
achievements.flavor: You drew the road to the onyx castle. Nobody should walk it.

achievements.name: Cartographer of the Unmapped
achievements.desc: Seed 55 free Pacts into new lists.
achievements.flavor: Every game begins on a map you drew.
achievements.title: Cartographer of the Unmapped

achievements.name: Nothing Remembers You Now
achievements.flavor: It had your name in its mouth. Not anymore.

achievements.name: Grudge Settled
achievements.flavor: Two names crossed out of the dark.

achievements.name: Captain-Breaker
achievements.flavor: The captains have started to count you.

achievements.name: Unforgotten, Unforgiving
achievements.flavor: You remember them as well as they remember you.

achievements.name: The Dark Keeps a List
achievements.flavor: Your name is on it, near the top.

achievements.name: Bane of Banes
achievements.flavor: They name their epithets after you now.

achievements.name: Shadow-Hunter
achievements.flavor: The hunted became the hunter.
achievements.title: the Shadow-Hunter

achievements.name: Ender of Grudges
achievements.flavor: Twenty-five grudges, twenty-five graves.

achievements.name: What the Dark Fears
achievements.flavor: Something down there has started to whisper about you.

achievements.name: Nemesis of Nemeses
achievements.flavor: Every captain in the dark knows one name.
achievements.title: Nemesis of Nemeses

achievements.name: Something Remembers
achievements.desc: Have 1 nemeses born from your deaths.
achievements.flavor: You died. It didn't forget.

achievements.name: Twice Remembered
achievements.desc: Have 2 nemeses born from your deaths.
achievements.flavor: Two things in the dark know your scent.

achievements.name: Popular in the Dark
achievements.desc: Have 3 nemeses born from your deaths.
achievements.flavor: They talk about you down there.

achievements.name: Maker of Monsters
achievements.desc: Have 5 nemeses born from your deaths.
achievements.flavor: Every loss leaves something behind.

achievements.name: A Grudge for Every Season
achievements.desc: Have 8 nemeses born from your deaths.
achievements.flavor: You feed the dark its villains.

achievements.name: Midwife of Horrors
achievements.desc: Have 12 nemeses born from your deaths.
achievements.flavor: The dark thanks you for your service.

achievements.name: Father of Captains
achievements.desc: Have 18 nemeses born from your deaths.
achievements.flavor: Half the board owes you its name.
achievements.title: Father of Captains

achievements.name: The Dark's Favourite Meal
achievements.desc: Have 25 nemeses born from your deaths.
achievements.flavor: You keep coming back, and so do they.

achievements.name: Origin Story
achievements.desc: Have 35 nemeses born from your deaths.
achievements.flavor: Every nemesis has one. Most of them are you.

achievements.name: Mother of Nemeses
achievements.desc: Have 50 nemeses born from your deaths.
achievements.flavor: The dark's whole hierarchy grew from your bones.
achievements.title: Mother of Nemeses

achievements.name: It Found You
achievements.desc: Be hunted down by a nemesis 1 times.
achievements.flavor: You heard it before you saw it.

achievements.name: Familiar Footsteps
achievements.desc: Be hunted down by a nemesis 4 times.
achievements.flavor: You know the sound now.

achievements.name: Hunted
achievements.desc: Be hunted down by a nemesis 6 times.
achievements.flavor: It always knows where you'll be.

achievements.name: Rendezvous in the Dark
achievements.desc: Be hunted down by a nemesis 10 times.
achievements.flavor: You almost look forward to it.

achievements.name: Old Acquaintance
achievements.desc: Be hunted down by a nemesis 16 times.
achievements.flavor: You nod at each other before it starts.

achievements.name: Marked
achievements.desc: Be hunted down by a nemesis 24 times.
achievements.flavor: Every captain can smell the mark on you.

achievements.name: Beloved of Horrors
achievements.desc: Be hunted down by a nemesis 36 times.
achievements.flavor: The dark keeps sending its best.
achievements.title: Beloved of Horrors

achievements.name: Never Alone Down There
achievements.desc: Be hunted down by a nemesis 50 times.
achievements.flavor: Something is always walking behind you.

achievements.name: The Dark's Appointment
achievements.desc: Be hunted down by a nemesis 70 times.
achievements.flavor: It's on the calendar. It always is.

achievements.name: Eternal Quarry
achievements.desc: Be hunted down by a nemesis 100 times.
achievements.flavor: A hundred hunts. You're still here.
achievements.title: the Eternal Quarry

achievements.name: Revenge Is a Dish
achievements.desc: Slay a nemesis that was born from your own death, 1 times.
achievements.flavor: Served cold, at the bottom of the dark.

achievements.name: Debt Collector
achievements.desc: Slay a nemesis that was born from your own death, 2 times.
achievements.flavor: It owed you a life.

achievements.name: Full Circle
achievements.desc: Slay a nemesis that was born from your own death, 3 times.
achievements.flavor: You made it. You ended it.

achievements.name: Cleaner of One's Own Mess
achievements.desc: Slay a nemesis that was born from your own death, 5 times.
achievements.flavor: Every monster you made, you unmade.

achievements.name: The Vengeful
achievements.desc: Slay a nemesis that was born from your own death, 8 times.
achievements.flavor: Nothing that kills you gets to keep it.

achievements.name: Grudge-Keeper
achievements.desc: Slay a nemesis that was born from your own death, 12 times.
achievements.flavor: Your memory is longer than theirs.

achievements.name: Avenger of Yourself
achievements.desc: Slay a nemesis that was born from your own death, 18 times.
achievements.flavor: Your past selves sleep easier.
achievements.title: the Avenger

achievements.name: Twenty-Five Reckonings
achievements.desc: Slay a nemesis that was born from your own death, 25 times.
achievements.flavor: You settle every account.

achievements.name: Unkillable Grudge
achievements.desc: Slay a nemesis that was born from your own death, 35 times.
achievements.flavor: Kill you once, and you'll come back for it.

achievements.name: The Last Word
achievements.desc: Slay a nemesis that was born from your own death, 50 times.
achievements.flavor: You always get it.
achievements.title: Keeper of the Last Word

achievements.name: Regicide
achievements.flavor: The dark has no king tonight.

achievements.name: Kingbreaker
achievements.flavor: Crowns don't last around you.

achievements.name: Usurper's Bane
achievements.flavor: Every new Warchief hears your name.

achievements.name: Throne-Smasher
achievements.flavor: The throne is getting expensive to replace.

achievements.name: Hand of the Congregation
achievements.flavor: Where the raid goes, you go first.

achievements.name: Dethroner
achievements.flavor: Twelve crowns in the dust.

achievements.name: Warchief's Doom
achievements.flavor: Being crowned is a death sentence now.
achievements.title: the Warchief's Doom

achievements.name: Ender of Dynasties
achievements.flavor: The dark has stopped bothering with crowns.

achievements.name: No Gods, No Warchiefs
achievements.flavor: Order in the dark is a thing of the past.

achievements.name: The Crown Itself
achievements.flavor: Fifty Warchiefs, one constant.
achievements.title: the Crown Itself

achievements.name: Tormentor
achievements.flavor: They see your face when they close their eyes.

achievements.name: Recurring Nightmare
achievements.flavor: Two souls dread your challenges.

achievements.name: The Circle's Bully
achievements.flavor: Rites with you end the same way.

achievements.name: Collector of Victims
achievements.flavor: Your trophy shelf has names on it.

achievements.name: Feared in the Circle
achievements.flavor: Some pretend not to see your challenge.

achievements.name: Despot of Duels
achievements.flavor: The circle is your court.

achievements.name: Lord of Torment
achievements.flavor: Eighteen people check chat for you first.
achievements.title: Lord of Torment

achievements.name: Bringer of Dread
achievements.flavor: Your challenge is an omen.

achievements.name: Shadow Over the Circle
achievements.flavor: Even the candles lean away from you.

achievements.name: The Eternal Tormentor
achievements.flavor: Fifty victims. Not one forgets.
achievements.title: the Eternal Tormentor

achievements.name: Bounty Hunter
achievements.desc: Collect 1 bounties on a Tormentor's head.
achievements.flavor: Someone had it coming.

achievements.name: Head Collector
achievements.desc: Collect 2 bounties on a Tormentor's head.
achievements.flavor: The board pays, and you collect.

achievements.name: Tormentor's Bane
achievements.desc: Collect 3 bounties on a Tormentor's head.
achievements.flavor: The bullies check if you're in chat.

achievements.name: Paid in Full
achievements.desc: Collect 5 bounties on a Tormentor's head.
achievements.flavor: Five bounties, five lessons.

achievements.name: Justice of the Circle
achievements.desc: Collect 8 bounties on a Tormentor's head.
achievements.flavor: The circle has a sheriff now.

achievements.name: The Board's Favourite
achievements.desc: Collect 12 bounties on a Tormentor's head.
achievements.flavor: Your name should be on the poster.

achievements.name: Scourge of Tormentors
achievements.desc: Collect 18 bounties on a Tormentor's head.
achievements.flavor: Nobody stays on top for long near you.
achievements.title: Scourge of Tormentors

achievements.name: Professional Hero
achievements.desc: Collect 25 bounties on a Tormentor's head.
achievements.flavor: It's a living.

achievements.name: Tormentor of Tormentors
achievements.desc: Collect 35 bounties on a Tormentor's head.
achievements.flavor: They tremble the way their victims did.

achievements.name: The Great Equaliser
achievements.desc: Collect 50 bounties on a Tormentor's head.
achievements.flavor: Fifty bullies brought low.
achievements.title: the Great Equaliser

achievements.name: Not Today
achievements.desc: Beat your Tormentor in a duel 1 times.
achievements.flavor: You hit back.

achievements.name: Biting Back
achievements.desc: Beat your Tormentor in a duel 2 times.
achievements.flavor: Twice now. They noticed.

achievements.name: The Worm Turns
achievements.desc: Beat your Tormentor in a duel 3 times.
achievements.flavor: Your Tormentor is getting nervous.

achievements.name: Unbowed
achievements.desc: Beat your Tormentor in a duel 5 times.
achievements.flavor: You kept stepping into the circle.

achievements.name: Defiant
achievements.desc: Beat your Tormentor in a duel 8 times.
achievements.flavor: Torment slides right off you.

achievements.name: The Grudge That Wins
achievements.desc: Beat your Tormentor in a duel 12 times.
achievements.flavor: Every loss just made you meaner.

achievements.name: Victim No More
achievements.desc: Beat your Tormentor in a duel 18 times.
achievements.flavor: Nobody torments you for long.
achievements.title: Victim No More

achievements.name: Revenge Incarnate
achievements.desc: Beat your Tormentor in a duel 25 times.
achievements.flavor: Twenty-five Tormentors regretted it.

achievements.name: The Turned Tables
achievements.desc: Beat your Tormentor in a duel 35 times.
achievements.flavor: You collect your own debts.

achievements.name: Unbreakable
achievements.desc: Beat your Tormentor in a duel 50 times.
achievements.flavor: Fifty times they had you. Fifty times you came back.
achievements.title: the Unbreakable

achievements.desc: Something keeps coming back for you.
Some losses grow up to rule.

achievements.name: Shadow-Breaker
achievements.desc: Hold the most nemesis kills of all time. The crown moves when someone overtakes you.
achievements.flavor: Every captain in the dark knows who holds this.
achievements.title: the Shadow-Breaker

achievements.name: Shadow-Hunter of the Month
achievements.desc: Slay the most nemeses in a calendar month.
achievements.flavor: This month, the dark learned your name.

achievements.name: Captain-Thief
achievements.flavor: It was hunting them. It found you instead.

achievements.name: Fear Conquered
achievements.flavor: Your hands stopped shaking just in time.

achievements.name: It Came Back
achievements.desc: Strike down a nemesis that crawls back, scarred.
achievements.flavor: You saw it die. You were sure.

achievements.name: Bane-Bearer
achievements.desc: Use a forged Bane against a nemesis.
achievements.flavor: Forged for one throat only.

achievements.name: Free at Last
achievements.flavor: The circle feels lighter.

achievements.name: Remembered by the Dark
achievements.flavor: Some deaths are personal.

achievements.name: The Lantern Catches
achievements.desc: Light the lantern and start a Delve run.
achievements.flavor: One stair down. Then another.

achievements.name: Stair-Counter
achievements.flavor: You stop counting the steps after the fortieth.

achievements.name: Oil and Nerve
achievements.flavor: The lantern smells of fish. Everything down there does.

achievements.name: Regular of the Dark
achievements.flavor: The things on the stair have started nodding at you.

achievements.name: Rope-Burned
achievements.flavor: Your palms remember every descent.

achievements.name: Familiar Footsteps
achievements.flavor: Something below knows the sound of your boots.

achievements.name: The Lamplighter
achievements.flavor: Every waystone wears a smear of your soot.
achievements.title: Lantern-Bearer of the Stair

achievements.name: Tenant of the Stair
achievements.flavor: You pay rent to the dark in Madness.

achievements.name: Nightly Pilgrim
achievements.flavor: Down is the only direction you trust.

achievements.name: Keeper of the Lantern
achievements.flavor: The flame went out long ago. You carry it anyway.
achievements.title: Keeper of the Lantern

achievements.name: One Step Further
achievements.flavor: Five depths. Three rooms. Breathe.

achievements.name: Further Still
achievements.flavor: The air gets heavier, and so does the bag.

achievements.name: Push Your Luck
achievements.flavor: Luck is a rope. It frays.

achievements.name: Downward Habit
achievements.flavor: Surfacing feels wrong now.

achievements.name: Room After Room
achievements.flavor: Doors that shouldn't open. You open them.

achievements.name: Lantern Oil Addict
achievements.flavor: You measure your days in oil.

achievements.name: The Ever-Pushing
achievements.flavor: Somewhere below, a door is always open for you.
achievements.title: the Ever-Pushing

achievements.name: Wearer of Stairs
achievements.flavor: The steps have worn into the shape of your boots.

achievements.name: Deeper Than Reason
achievements.flavor: Reason stayed on the surface.

achievements.name: The One Who Never Turns Back
achievements.flavor: There is no up. There never was.
achievements.title: Who Never Turns Back

achievements.name: Floor of the World
achievements.desc: Break the lord at the Bottom of any ladder.
achievements.flavor: Depth 100. It was waiting. Now it isn't.

achievements.name: Twice to the Floor
achievements.flavor: The second throne room is no less terrible.

achievements.name: Throne-Toppler
achievements.flavor: Lords fall. You keep walking out.

achievements.name: Regicide Below
achievements.flavor: The dark has run short of kings.

achievements.name: Crown Collector
achievements.flavor: Your satchel clinks with stolen regalia.

achievements.name: Scourge of Lords
achievements.flavor: The lords below whisper your name to their heirs.

achievements.name: Breaker of the Bottom
achievements.flavor: The floor of the world has cracks now. You made them.
achievements.title: Breaker of the Bottom

achievements.name: The Dark's Last Problem
achievements.flavor: Whatever rises at depth 100 rises nervously.

achievements.name: Below the Below
achievements.flavor: You have found what lies under the Bottom. It's you.

achievements.name: Lord Below
achievements.flavor: Every throne at the Bottom has your name scratched on it.
achievements.title: Lord Below

achievements.name: First Haul
achievements.desc: Carry 2,000 Madness of haul up from the Delve.
achievements.flavor: It's damp. It counts.

achievements.name: Pockets Full of Dark
achievements.desc: Carry 6,000 Madness of haul up from the Delve.
achievements.flavor: Something in the bag is still warm.

achievements.name: Treasure-Lugger
achievements.desc: Carry 16,000 Madness of haul up from the Delve.
achievements.flavor: Your back aches. Your purse doesn't.

achievements.name: Salvager of Ruin
achievements.desc: Carry 40,000 Madness of haul up from the Delve.
achievements.flavor: Dead delvers leave such generous pockets.

achievements.name: Hoard-Hauler
achievements.desc: Carry 80,000 Madness of haul up from the Delve.
achievements.flavor: Gold, teeth, and things that might be both.

achievements.name: The Glutted Satchel
achievements.desc: Carry 160,000 Madness of haul up from the Delve.
achievements.flavor: The seams hold. Barely.

achievements.name: Lantern-Rich
achievements.desc: Carry 320,000 Madness of haul up from the Delve.
achievements.flavor: You came back up with more than you took down. Every time.
achievements.title: the Lantern-Rich

achievements.name: Robber of the Deep Places
achievements.desc: Carry 640,000 Madness of haul up from the Delve.
achievements.flavor: The dark keeps a ledger. You're on every page.

achievements.name: Bleeder of the Underworld
achievements.desc: Carry 1,200,000 Madness of haul up from the Delve.
achievements.flavor: The stair is lighter for your visits.

achievements.name: Who Emptied the Dark
achievements.desc: Carry 2,000,000 Madness of haul up from the Delve.
achievements.flavor: There is nothing left down there to steal. Probably.
achievements.title: Who Emptied the Dark

achievements.name: The Dark Keeps You
achievements.flavor: The lantern rolls down the stair without you.

achievements.name: Familiar Grave
achievements.flavor: Your old bones wave hello.

achievements.name: Ten Funerals
achievements.flavor: You have a favourite spot to fall now.

achievements.name: Bones on Every Landing
achievements.flavor: Other delvers use your remains as waymarks.

achievements.name: Feeder of the Stair
achievements.flavor: The dark has grown fat on you, and it is grateful.

achievements.name: Someone Else's Bones
achievements.flavor: They won't be needing it.

achievements.name: Grave-Picker
achievements.desc: Find 3 fallen packs in the Delve.
achievements.flavor: Finders keepers. Losers stay down there.

achievements.name: Scavenger of the Stair
achievements.desc: Find 8 fallen packs in the Delve.
achievements.flavor: You check every corpse for pockets.

achievements.name: Inheritor of the Fallen
achievements.desc: Find 15 fallen packs in the Delve.
achievements.flavor: The dead keep leaving you things.

achievements.name: Ossuary Accountant
achievements.desc: Find 30 fallen packs in the Delve.
achievements.flavor: You keep a list of who fell where. For business reasons.

achievements.name: Below the First Stair
achievements.flavor: The daylight is a coin-sized circle above you.

achievements.name: Wet Stone, Cold Air
achievements.flavor: Things splash in the dark, just out of the lantern's reach.

achievements.name: Halfway Down the Shallows
achievements.flavor: The stair to the Deep opens for you.

achievements.name: Where the Shallows End
achievements.flavor: The water here has never seen light.

achievements.name: At the Shallows' Floor
achievements.flavor: One more push and something will rise to meet you.

achievements.name: Into the Deep
achievements.flavor: The stone sweats. The stair narrows.

achievements.name: Where Gugs Walk
achievements.flavor: Huge footprints cross the stair. They're fresh.

achievements.name: Halfway Down the Deep
achievements.flavor: The Abyss opens its door to you.

achievements.name: The Deep's Lower Halls
achievements.flavor: Pillars older than the moon hold up the dark.

achievements.name: At the Deep's Floor
achievements.flavor: A throne room waits. You can hear it breathing.

achievements.name: The Abyss Looks Back
achievements.flavor: The lantern dims, as if ashamed.

achievements.name: Breathing Black
achievements.flavor: The dark here is thick enough to drink.

achievements.name: Halfway to Nothing
achievements.flavor: Your shadow stopped following you a while ago.

achievements.name: Where the Stars Are Wrong
achievements.flavor: There are stars down here. They should not be.

achievements.name: Walker of the Abyss
achievements.flavor: Few go this deep. Fewer remember how they got back.
achievements.title: Walker of the Abyss

achievements.name: Lord of the Shallows Falls
achievements.desc: Break the lord at the Bottom of the Shallows.
achievements.flavor: The Shallows have a floor. You've stood on it, over a fallen lord.
achievements.title: Floor-Finder of the Shallows

achievements.name: The Deep Has a Bottom
achievements.desc: Break the lord at the Bottom of the Deep.
achievements.flavor: They said the Deep went on forever. They were wrong, and now its lord is dead.
achievements.title: Breaker of the Deep

achievements.name: The Floor of the Abyss
achievements.desc: Break the lord at the Bottom of the Abyss.
achievements.flavor: There is no deeper. You went there, and you came back.
achievements.title: Who Came Back from the Abyss

achievements.name: Two Hundred Mouths
achievements.desc: Drop a gift bomb of 200 or more subs.
achievements.flavor: Every one of them is hungry, and every one of them is grateful.

achievements.name: The Spawning Tide
achievements.desc: Drop a gift bomb of 300 or more subs.
achievements.flavor: The pit has overflowed into the street.
achievements.title: Tide of Spawn

achievements.name: Brood Without End
achievements.desc: Drop a gift bomb of 500 or more subs.
achievements.flavor: Five hundred eyes open at once.

achievements.name: The Shoggoth Rain
achievements.desc: Drop a gift bomb of 750 or more subs.
achievements.flavor: It is raining protoplasm, and everyone is subscribed.

achievements.name: Tekeli-li a Thousand Times
achievements.desc: Drop a gift bomb of 1,000 or more subs.
achievements.flavor: The most the sky can hold at once. You emptied it.
achievements.title: Mother of the Thousand Spawn

achievements.name: Through the Gate
achievements.desc: YouTube: become a member for the first time.
achievements.flavor: A door you didn't know was there swings open.

achievements.name: Opener of the Way
achievements.desc: YouTube: stay a member for 6 months.
achievements.flavor: Half a year on the far side of the gate.

achievements.name: Walker Between Spheres
achievements.desc: YouTube: stay a member for 24 months.
achievements.flavor: Two years. Space bends politely around you.

achievements.name: The All-in-One
achievements.desc: YouTube: stay a member for 36 months.
achievements.flavor: Three years. You are starting to see every angle at once.

achievements.name: Keeper of the Silver Gate
achievements.desc: YouTube: stay a member for 48 months.
achievements.flavor: Four years. The gate opens before you knock.
achievements.title: Keeper of the Silver Gate

achievements.name: Spawn of Yog-Sothoth
achievements.desc: YouTube: stay a member for 60 months.
achievements.flavor: Five years. Your family tree has angles it shouldn't.

achievements.name: Lurker at the Threshold
achievements.desc: YouTube: stay a member for 84 months.
achievements.flavor: Seven years. You have stopped using doors.

achievements.name: Yog-Sothoth Is the Gate
achievements.desc: YouTube: stay a member for 120 months.
achievements.flavor: Ten years. You are the key, the gate and the guardian.
achievements.title: the Key and the Gate

achievements.name: A Name in the Ledger

achievements.name: Keeper of Forbidden Curios
achievements.flavor: Every set, every piece. Nothing in the collection is missing, except your peace of mind.
achievements.title: the Keeper of Curios

achievements.name: Pnakotic Scholar
achievements.desc: Complete a curio set: Pnakotic Scholar.
achievements.flavor: Every fragment of the Manuscripts, read. You wish you hadn't.
achievements.title: the Pnakotic Scholar

achievements.name: Kin of Dunwich
achievements.desc: Complete a curio set: Kin of Dunwich.
achievements.flavor: The Whateley heirlooms are yours. The whippoorwills sing when you pass.
achievements.title: Kin of Dunwich

achievements.name: Innsmouth Blood
achievements.desc: Complete a curio set: Innsmouth Blood.
achievements.flavor: The Marsh regalia fits you. A little too well.
achievements.title: of Innsmouth Blood

achievements.name: Weaver of Leng
achievements.desc: Complete a curio set: Weaver of Leng.
achievements.flavor: Every tapestry of Leng, hung. The figures in them have started to move.
achievements.title: the Weaver of Leng

achievements.name: Miskatonic Alumnus
achievements.desc: Complete a curio set: Miskatonic Alumnus.
achievements.flavor: The whole collection of the Miskatonic, returned to a better home.
achievements.title: the Miskatonic Alumnus

achievements.name: Friend of Cats
achievements.desc: Complete a curio set: Friend of Cats.
achievements.flavor: All the trinkets of Ulthar. No cat will ever be harmed near you.
achievements.title: the Friend of Cats

achievements.name: Keeper of the Charter
achievements.desc: Complete a curio set: Keeper of the Charter.
achievements.flavor: Every relic of the Esoteric Order, gathered. The Charter is safe with you.
achievements.title: the Keeper of the Charter

achievements.name: First Dream
achievements.desc: Bring 1 dreamers home from the Dreamlands.
achievements.flavor: A dreamer came home from the Dreamlands.

achievements.name: Frequent Dreamer
achievements.desc: Bring 10 dreamers home from the Dreamlands.
achievements.flavor: Ten dreams. Your pillow smells of Ulthar.

achievements.name: Lucid
achievements.desc: Bring 50 dreamers home from the Dreamlands.
achievements.flavor: Fifty quests. You know the Dreamlands better than the waking world.

achievements.name: Dweller in Dreams
achievements.desc: Bring 150 dreamers home from the Dreamlands.
achievements.flavor: A hundred and fifty. Which side is the dream again?

achievements.name: Over the Seventy Steps
achievements.flavor: Three regions of the Dreamlands seen.

achievements.name: Dreamer of Every Shore
achievements.flavor: Every region, Kadath included.
achievements.title: the Wakeful Dreamer

achievements.name: Guest of the Great Ones
achievements.desc: Bring an Eldritch Pact home from the gods' own table at Unknown Kadath.
achievements.flavor: You sat at their table. They didn't notice. That's the best possible outcome.
achievements.title: Who Has Seen Kadath

achievements.name: The Cold Plateau
achievements.desc: Reach the Plateau of Leng in a Dreamland quest.
achievements.flavor: The men of Leng bowed. You didn't like how deeply.

achievements.name: Choose Your Dream
achievements.flavor: Ten choices in the Dreamlands.

achievements.name: Author of Dreams
achievements.flavor: A hundred. The Dreamlands are starting to follow your plot.

achievements.name: Rope Burn
achievements.desc: Push or pull a tug-of-war timer 1 times.
achievements.flavor: Ten tugs on the Hourglass's rope.

achievements.name: Hand Over Hand
achievements.desc: Push or pull a tug-of-war timer 100 times.
achievements.flavor: A hundred tugs. Your palms remember.

achievements.name: Tug of the Ages
achievements.desc: Push or pull a tug-of-war timer 500 times.
achievements.flavor: Five hundred. Yog-Sothoth knows your grip.

achievements.name: Founding Faithful
achievements.desc: Be counted by the Esoteric Order of the Tentacle in its first month.
achievements.flavor: You were there when the Order lit its first candle.
achievements.title: the Founding Faithful

achievements.name: The Lightless
achievements.desc: Earn half of all Delve achievements.
achievements.flavor: Half the dark is mapped. The other half has started mapping you.
achievements.title: the Lightless

achievements.name: Warden of the Lower Dark
achievements.flavor: Every ladder, every branch, every lord below. The dark answers to you now.
achievements.title: Warden of the Lower Dark

achievements.name: Keeper of Forbidden Lore
achievements.desc: Answer the riddles to their last tier, reach every region of the Dreamlands and complete the seven open curio sets.
achievements.flavor: Riddles, dreams and relics. There is nothing left that you're not supposed to know.
achievements.title: Keeper of Forbidden Lore

achievements.name: Dreamer Beyond the Gate
achievements.flavor: You walked through the Gate of Deeper Slumber and kept walking.
achievements.title: Dreamer Beyond the Gate

achievements.name: Initiate of the Codex
achievements.flavor: Fifty achievements. The Codex has learned your name.
achievements.title: the Initiate

achievements.name: Acolyte of the Codex
achievements.flavor: A hundred and fifty. The pages turn when you walk past.
achievements.title: the Acolyte

achievements.name: Adept of the Codex
achievements.flavor: Four hundred. You've started writing in the margins.
achievements.title: the Adept

achievements.name: Hierophant of the Codex
achievements.flavor: Eight hundred. The Codex reads you now.
achievements.title: the Hierophant

achievements.name: Elder of the Union
achievements.flavor: Twelve hundred. There are fewer achievements left than there are stars.
achievements.title: Elder of the Union

achievements.name: Survivor of Yule, 2026
achievements.desc: Be at a stream during Yule 2026.
achievements.flavor: The candles burned down to the longest night, and you were still there.
achievements.title: Survivor of Yule 2026

achievements.name: Kept the Vigil, 2026
achievements.flavor: Six weeks, six candles. You watched every one of them burn.
achievements.title: Keeper of the 2026 Vigil

achievements.name: Lucia's Light, 2026
achievements.flavor: She walked in with candles in her hair, and one of them was for you.

achievements.name: Guest at the Festival, 2026
achievements.desc: Be at a stream during the Festival, 2026.
achievements.flavor: You climbed the hill at Kingsport with the lanterns. You remember coming back down. Mostly.

achievements.name: The Ledger Turns, 2026
achievements.desc: Be there when the ledger turns its page, 2026.
achievements.flavor: One more year written in ink that never quite dries.

achievements.name: Survivor of Yule, 2027
achievements.desc: Be at a stream during Yule 2027.
achievements.flavor: The candles burned down to the longest night, and you were still there.
achievements.title: Survivor of Yule 2027

achievements.name: Kept the Vigil, 2027
achievements.flavor: Six weeks, six candles. You watched every one of them burn.
achievements.title: Keeper of the 2027 Vigil

achievements.name: Lucia's Light, 2027
achievements.flavor: She walked in with candles in her hair, and one of them was for you.

achievements.name: Guest at the Festival, 2027
achievements.desc: Be at a stream during the Festival, 2027.
achievements.flavor: You climbed the hill at Kingsport with the lanterns. You remember coming back down. Mostly.

achievements.name: The Ledger Turns, 2027
achievements.desc: Be there when the ledger turns its page, 2027.
achievements.flavor: One more year written in ink that never quite dries.

achievements.name: Was There: the 8th Streamaversary, 2027
achievements.flavor: Your name is in the ledger for the night it turned another year.
achievements.title: Was There (2027)

achievements.name: Was There: the 9th Streamaversary, 2028
achievements.flavor: Your name is in the ledger for the night it turned another year.
achievements.title: Was There (2028)

achievements.name: Moonstruck
achievements.desc: Be at a stream on a Moon Night.
achievements.flavor: The full moon looked down at the stream, and you looked back.

achievements.name: Lunatic
achievements.flavor: Six full moons. You've started howling a little.

achievements.name: Child of the Moon
achievements.flavor: Two dozen full moons. The moon-beasts nod when you pass.
achievements.title: Child of the Moon

achievements.name: Friday the Thirteenth
achievements.desc: Be at a stream on Friday the 13th.
achievements.flavor: Black cats, broken mirrors, and you. Nothing happened. Probably.

achievements.name: Hill Fires
achievements.desc: Be at a stream during Hallowmass.
achievements.flavor: The fires burned on Sentinel Hill, and you watched from a safe distance.

achievements.name: Danced Round the Pole
achievements.desc: Be at a stream on Midsommar.
achievements.flavor: You danced. The Hårga smiled. You left before the ninth day.

achievements.name: By the Valborg Fire
achievements.flavor: The bonfire burned, spring came, nobody was sacrificed. This time.

achievements.name: Saw R'lyeh Rise
achievements.desc: Be at a stream while R'lyeh has risen.
achievements.flavor: The city of wrong angles broke the surface, and you looked at it.

achievements.name: Ate the Cake
achievements.flavor: The cake had too many eyes. You ate it anyway.

achievements.name: More Time!
achievements.desc: Extend a running Hourglass challenge 1 times.
achievements.flavor: You poured more sand into someone else's challenge.

achievements.name: Prolonger of Suffering
achievements.desc: Extend a running Hourglass challenge 10 times.
achievements.flavor: Ten extensions. Dave has stopped thanking you.

achievements.name: Lord of the Long Minute
achievements.desc: Extend a running Hourglass challenge 50 times.
achievements.flavor: Fifty. Yog-Sothoth knows your hand on the Hourglass.
achievements.title: Lord of the Long Minute

achievements.name: Pocket Change
achievements.desc: Take 1 Stolen Coins from treasure goblins.
achievements.flavor: Ten Stolen Coins shaken out of a goblin.

achievements.name: Goblin Banker
achievements.desc: Take 100 Stolen Coins from treasure goblins.
achievements.flavor: A hundred coins. The goblins have started to keep their distance.

achievements.name: Treasurer of Thieves
achievements.desc: Take 500 Stolen Coins from treasure goblins.
achievements.flavor: Five hundred. Every goblin in the dark knows your face.
achievements.title: Treasurer of Thieves

achievements.name: A Coin for the Circle
achievements.desc: Give €5 (or the same in bits, KICKs or a Super Chat) into summoning circles.
achievements.flavor: The chalk drank it. Something on the other side said thank you.

achievements.name: Patron of the Summoning
achievements.flavor: Fifty euros of candles, chalk and things better left unnamed.

achievements.name: The Circle's Benefactor
achievements.flavor: The circles glow a little brighter when you're in chat.
achievements.title: the Circle's Benefactor

achievements.name: First Spark
achievements.desc: Forge 1 things in the Gibbering Forge (/forge craft).
achievements.flavor: Your first thing forged. It's warm and slightly damp.

achievements.name: Apprentice of the Anvil
achievements.desc: Forge 25 things in the Gibbering Forge (/forge craft).
achievements.flavor: Twenty-five forgings. The anvil knows your hand.

achievements.name: Journeyman of the Forge
achievements.desc: Forge 100 things in the Gibbering Forge (/forge craft).
achievements.flavor: A hundred. The bellows breathe in time with you.

achievements.name: Smith of Unspeakable Things
achievements.desc: Forge 500 things in the Gibbering Forge (/forge craft).
achievements.flavor: Five hundred. Nobody asks what you're making any more.
achievements.title: the Unspeakable Smith

achievements.name: Waste Not
achievements.desc: Salvage 1 things in the Gibbering Forge.
achievements.flavor: Ten things broken back down into materials.

achievements.name: Scrap-Priest
achievements.desc: Salvage 100 things in the Gibbering Forge.
achievements.flavor: A hundred salvages. Nothing is ever really thrown away.

achievements.name: Bait-Maker
achievements.flavor: Five lures. Something down there has started sniffing.

achievements.name: Master of Lures
achievements.flavor: Fifty lures. The deep things come when you whistle.

achievements.name: Key-Cutter
achievements.flavor: Your first Gate Key. It hums.

achievements.name: Warden of Keys
achievements.flavor: Ten Gate Keys. Every lock below knows your shape.

achievements.name: Refiner
achievements.flavor: Ten refinings. Purer, stranger, better.

achievements.name: Alchemist of the Deep
achievements.flavor: A hundred refinings.

achievements.name: Outfitter
achievements.flavor: Ten Torches, Ropes and Salves for the dark.

achievements.name: Quartermaster of the Lower Dark
achievements.flavor: A hundred tools forged for the Delve.

achievements.name: Armed for the Dark
achievements.flavor: Your first piece of Delve gear.

achievements.name: Armourer of the Abyss
achievements.flavor: Ten pieces of Delve gear forged.

achievements.name: Relic-Wright
achievements.flavor: A relic, forged by your own hand.

achievements.name: Keeper of the Reliquary
achievements.flavor: Ten relics forged.

achievements.name: Master of the Gibbering Forge
achievements.desc: Earn every crafting achievement of the Gibbering Forge.
achievements.flavor: Lures, keys, relics, gear and a mountain of scrap. The Forge answers to you.
achievements.title: Forgemaster

achievements.name: Half the Year Remembered
achievements.desc: Hold 6 different Shards of the Month from the Remembrance.
achievements.flavor: Six Shards of the Month. Half a year of the Old Ones' memory.

achievements.name: The Turning Year
achievements.desc: Hold 12 different Shards of the Month from the Remembrance.
achievements.flavor: All twelve Shards. A whole year, held in your hands.
achievements.title: Keeper of the Turning Year
